'''Sweetgreen''' was a fruit native to [[Parein II 4/Legends|Parein II 4]]. It was used, along with [[Terrberry|terrberries]] and [[spicy nut]]s to make an alcoholic beverage known as [[daranu]].<ref name="Fragments">[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]</ref>
